Maintainer
Thanks for asking this here instead of guessing — this needed a written answer, and it now has one in the repo:
BOUNTY.md → "Payout rails, dates, and fees (plan of record)"
(landed
9a0056e
). The short form, per question:
1. Fees — none, ever.
No registration, platform, verification, deposit, or prize-claim fee at any stage. Any party asking contributors to pay to claim a bounty under this program's name is not us; flag it and we will call it out publicly. (This answers @Xgoyeezy's question directly.)
2. Rail.
The leading candidate is
USDC on Base to a self-custody wallet
— driven by what contributors here have actually asked for. The final rail decision gets posted
in writing in this discussion before the 2026-11-01 window opens
, and BOUNTY.md updates the moment it's confirmed. If you need a different rail, say so here before that date; we are reading this thread.
3. Amounts
are USD-denominated as listed in the tables; not re-denominated at payout.
4. Identity/tax documents:
nothing is required to
submit
. A chosen rail may impose its own payout-time requirements (fiat rails usually mean KYC); whatever applies will be stated in the rail confirmation. Stablecoin self-custody has no identity requirement from us.
5. Dates and the "holding work" question (
@xuedaban
):
triage is continuous and the review windows are verdict dates, not submission deadlines —
do not hold contribution work waiting for rails.
Work submitted now gets the same verification pipeline (repro on main → patched repro → battery) as work submitted after the rail lands. The M1 wildcard window opens 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC; payout preparation starts after the window's last verdict.
6. Geography:
eligibility for submission and review is merit-based and location-agnostic. Payout works wherever the confirmed rail works; if your jurisdiction blocks it, we will work out an alternative case by case — say so here.
